description:
This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

The insane tactic of towing gliders full of troops into combat: C-47 and Ju 52 tugs hauled unpowered gliders by cable, then cut them loose to land silent with intact units, vehicles, and light guns. Solved dispersal and heavy-weapons limits—crashes were the price. Before helicopters, this was how airborne forces arrived together. Worth the risk?
